note: Layout Builder Symmetric Translations translates the content of Layout Builder per-entity overrides. It has no config form/route/permission. Its concrete, verifiable behaviour: when a bundle gets Layout Builder overrides enabled, the module's overridden entity_view_display class auto-adds a locked, translatable field 'layout_builder__translation' (field type 'layout_translation') to that bundle. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that: introspection reads the auto-added field on a bundle with overrides enabled; execution enables overrides on a bundle (node.article / node.page) and verifies the translation field was auto-created on the live site. Fixtures touch only Layout Builder's own fields (layout_builder__layout, layout_builder__translation) on core bundles and are fully torn down.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal layout_builder_st (Layout Builder Symmetric Translations) module let you do that core Layout Builder does not, and what does 'symmetric' mean here?
evals.expected_output: It lets editors translate the CONTENT of Layout Builder per-entity overrides (inline block text and translatable component/block labels). 'Symmetric' means every language shares the same layout structure (same sections/components); only translatable strings differ per language.

evals.prompt: When layout_builder_st is installed and a content type has Layout Builder overrides enabled, what field does the module add to that bundle to store translated layout data, and what is that field's type?
evals.expected_output: It adds a locked, translatable field named layout_builder__translation of field type layout_translation to the bundle (created automatically by the module's overridden entity_view_display class / install hook).

evals.prompt: Is layout_builder_st compatible with Layout Builder Asymmetric Translations (layout_builder_at)? And does layout_builder_st have its own admin settings page?
evals.expected_output: No — layout_builder_st is mutually exclusive with layout_builder_at; enabling both raises a requirements error, so uninstall one. It has no settings form and no configure route; you enable Layout Builder overrides + content translation and translate a layout via the UI.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has Layout Builder overrides enabled and layout_builder_st is installed. Inspect the live field configuration for node.article and give the machine name of the field layout_builder_st added to store translation data.
evals.expected_output: The field is layout_builder__translation (a FieldConfig on node.article, added by layout_builder_st). Check with: drush php:eval reading FieldConfig::loadByName('node','article','layout_builder__translation').

evals.prompt: On this site, node.article has a field named layout_builder__translation added by layout_builder_st. Inspect the live field storage and report its field type and whether it is translatable.
evals.expected_output: The field storage layout_builder__translation is of type 'layout_translation' and is translatable (and locked). Inspect FieldStorageConfig::loadByName('node','layout_builder__translation').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site (layout_builder_st is installed), enable Layout Builder overrides on the Article content type's default view display so that its per-entity layouts can be translated. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable Layout Builder with per-entity overrides on the node.article default view display (e.g. $display->enableLayoutBuilder()->setOverridable(TRUE)->save(), or via Manage display -> Layout options). layout_builder_st then auto-creates the layout_builder__translation FieldConfig on node.article, which verify checks.

evals.prompt: I want my Basic page content to have layouts I can customize per page and later translate. On this Drupal site, turn on the customizable per-page layout feature for the Basic page content type.
evals.expected_output: Enable Layout Builder with per-entity overrides on the node.page default view display. With layout_builder_st installed this auto-creates the layout_builder__translation FieldConfig on node.page, which verify checks.
